about_the_game:
Add soft colors and clothing adorned with ribbons and bows to your Sims’ wardrobe with The Sims 4 Sweet Allure Kit*. With fashion featuring light colors and clothing adorned with ruffles and frills, the clothing and accessories in this kit give off an elegant vibe with their everyday looks. Express a more delicate side to a Sims’ fashion sense, effortlessly giving your Sim a casual coquette fashion feel. Created by aharris00britney.

KEY FEATURES
  • Soft and Sweet Elegance — Whether for a formal event, a walk in the garden, or a simple brunch, adorn your Sims with pearl necklaces, soft sweaters, and delicate cute skirts for them to live out their coquette fashion fantasies.
